cleanupActions.notes: Raw capture output (screenshots, exports, run logs) lives outside Git under the external evidence root. Review, then delete after redacted copies are approved. Substitute the real disposable run id locally; never record an actual run id or tenant data here.
Retain only the sanitized, SHA-256-hashed images referenced by the report manifest; delete every other redacted artifact from the external evidence root.

cleanupActions.location: Disposable copilot-agent-inventory lab assets (discovery flow, temporary agent or app, and any seeded rows) in a throwaway lab environment.
cleanupActions.notes: Tear down disposable flow and assets after evidence capture. Environment identifiers and tenant values stay in the private lab repository and are never recorded here.
Only approved, redacted PNGs listed in copilot-agent-inventory/docs/lab-validation-evidence.json are retained and published. Remove any unlisted PNG so the evidence manifest stays authoritative.

rollbackActions.description: If the sanitized report must be withdrawn, git revert the commit that added copilot-agent-inventory/docs/lab-validation.md together with its docs/img PNGs and lab-validation-evidence.json.

Delete the external, non-Git evidence root for the run (for example C:\FSI-Lab-Evidence\copilot-agent-inventory\<runId>) through the local runbook. Raw evidence is never committed, so no history rewrite is required.
